key_facts: Gabriel Bortoleto, driving car 5 for Audi Revolut F1 Team, moved his car under braking into Turn 5 during the race at the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix on 13 September 2026.
Car 5 impacted car 43 in a way that caused car 43 to leave the track.
The infringement was a breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 e) of the FIA International Sporting Code, which prohibits moving under braking.
The Stewards issued a Warning to Bortoleto, which is equivalent to a black/white flag (a warning for unsportsmanlike driving).
plain_explanation: At the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix, Gabriel Bortoleto (car 5, Audi Revolut F1 Team) was given a Warning during the race for moving under braking into Turn 5. His car hit car 43 and forced it off the track. The rules say you cannot move your car under braking—this is to keep racing fair and safe. A Warning is the standard penalty for this breach. It is the same as a black/white flag, which tells a driver they have committed an unsportsmanlike action and will face a penalty if they do it again.
